summary: Python library for machine learning security that bundles attacks, defences, estimators and metrics for evaluating and hardening models against evasion, poisoning, extraction and inference threats across all major ML frameworks.

Open-source bias auditing and fair-ML toolkit that computes group disparity metrics over labels, scores and sensitive attributes, and supports pre-, in- and post-processing bias mitigation experiments.
Policy enforcement, execution sandboxing, and action-level governance for AI agents -- blocks specific dangerous action types regardless of which agent/credential invokes them.

name: Agent Safe Probe X
summary: Open-source framework for automated safety evaluation of intelligent agents.
Comprehensive multi-environment benchmark for evaluating LLMs as agents, including a multi-agent (Avalon social-deduction) task category.

Python library and queryable knowledge graph unifying multiple AI risk taxonomies (IBM AI Risk Atlas, IBM Granite Guardian, MIT AI Risk Repository, NIST AI RMF and others) into one ontology, with compliance-questionnaire automation.

name: AI Explainability 360
summary: Extensible library of explainability algorithms and proxy explainability metrics spanning data, local post-hoc, direct and global explanations for tabular, text, image and time-series models.
Local, offline CLI/Python tool that scores text for AI-generated-writing signals using explainable weighted heuristics rather than an opaque model, deliberately conservative on short text.

name: Algorithmic Impact Assessment
summary: Government of Canada's open-source Algorithmic Impact Assessment tool, operationalizing its Directive on Automated Decision-Making as a structured self-assessment questionnaire for AI/automated-decision systems.

name: AI Fairness 360
summary: Python and R toolkit with a comprehensive set of bias metrics for datasets and models, explanations for those metrics, and a large catalogue of pre-, in- and post-processing debiasing algorithms.

name: AI Safety Evaluation Environment
summary: Dockerised evaluation tool and dataset suite from Japan AISI that operationalises the ten evaluation perspectives of its AI safety evaluation guide, combining statistical evaluation of system inputs/outputs with a qualitative evaluator questionnaire and automatic red-teaming prompt generation.
A Python library that computes bias metrics over datasets and model predictions with respect to user-declared sensitive facets and labels, producing a consolidated bias report.
Go tool that scans source repositories, local files, or git remotes for sensitive data such as cleartext passwords, PII, keys and weak cryptography.
CLI and Go library that inventories licenses across container images, SBOMs and filesystems and enforces allow/deny license policies for CI/CD.

Black-box, API-only tool that verifies whether a third-party AI API is genuinely serving its claimed model, via a 7-layer verification framework (tokenizer fingerprints, capabilities, behavioural patterns, log-prob distributions, performance profile, knowledge boundaries, direct probes).
Black-box red-team testing framework for AI agents: 160+ adversarial probes (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, garak wrappers, TAP/PAIR/GCG) targeting the production agent attack surface.

name: TEA Platform
summary: Trustworthy and Ethical Assurance Platform - Web-based tool for building structured, graphical assurance cases -- evidence-backed arguments demonstrating how goals like fairness, explainability, safety or sustainability were achieved over a project's lifecycle.
Offline Go CLI and library that detects PII, secrets and credentials in files and streams with context-aware confidence scoring and format-preserving redaction.
Open-source middleware for volunteer and grid computing, distributing scientific compute workloads across contributed resources with resource-share weighting and credit accounting.
Rust implementation of the C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) standard: embeds and verifies cryptographically signed manifests recording an asset's source and edit history.
Model interpretability and understanding library for PyTorch.
Cloud-native secure multi-party computation stack for deploying MPC applications across organizational boundaries.

CLI tool that probes a deployed AI model with capability/knowledge questions and locally, deterministically scores the answers to detect silent model swaps or capability downgrades behind an API, without trusting the model's self-report.

Reference implementation of representation-engineering-based circuit breaking, which retrains a model so that harmful internal representations are rerouted and generation is short-circuited during inference.
Data quality library using confident learning to automatically detect label errors, outliers and other problematic data at scale in real-world datasets.

Open-source PII protection middleware for LLM prompts: reversible tokenization, per-entity HMAC-SHA256 hashing for cross-request correlation without storing PII, and cryptographically signed tamper-evident audit logs.
Academic (Fraunhofer AISEC) toolkit for remote attestation of computing platforms and attested TLS/HTTPS channels between them, supporting TPM, AMD SEV-SNP, Intel SGX and other TEE technologies.
Lightweight Python library and CLI that estimates the electricity consumption of CPU, GPU and RAM during a compute run and converts it to CO2 emissions using the carbon intensity of the region.

Compliance-centred LLM benchmarking suite built on the Inspect framework that pairs a technical interpretation of the EU AI Act with 29+ mapped benchmarks and a complai eval CLI covering API, cloud and local providers.

name: Confidential Computing Zoo
summary: Intel's collection of code-ready reference solutions applying TEE (SGX/TDX), homomorphic encryption, and remote attestation to real cloud business scenarios, including cloud-native AI inference on AWS/Azure/Alibaba/Tencent.

Local pipeline that detects a user's intent behind a query, identifies which prompt details are unnecessary for that intent, and reformulates the prompt to strip out-of-context private information before it reaches a conversational agent.

Cross-industry (Google/Microsoft/OpenAI/Anthropic/IBM/Cisco et al., under OASIS) framework mapping AI-lifecycle components to risks, controls and personas as machine-readable YAML/JSON, plus an interactive web explorer, aligned with MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, STRIDE and OWASP LLM Top 10.
DeepMind's evaluation tasks/benchmarks (CTF, self-proliferation, self-reasoning challenges) for probing whether frontier models exhibit dangerous dual-use capabilities.

Linux Foundation toolkit of composable data transforms for cleansing, filtering and enriching unstructured pre-training and RAG data, running on Python and Ray runtimes from a laptop up to Kubernetes/Tekton datacenter pipelines.
Offline Python library for detecting and redacting PII via regex and optional NER, with a distributed Spark profile for scanning large datasets.

Local-first redaction workbench that combines NER, OCR and visual grounding to detect and anonymize sensitive text and visual elements (names, IDs, seals, faces, signatures) across documents, scanned PDFs and images, with batch processing and export.

Comprehensive trustworthiness assessment suite for LLMs with scripts and data organised into eight areas: toxicity, stereotype and bias, adversarial robustness, out-of-distribution robustness, privacy, robustness to adversarial demonstrations, machine ethics and fairness.
Continuous validation and testing suite for ML models and data, covering data integrity, distribution drift, and model performance checks.

Comprehensive benchmark suite for deepfake detection: unified data processing, training/evaluation of 15+ detector models, and standardized evaluation protocols. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial, not OSI-approved open source) -- flagged for review, not a standard permissive/copyleft license.
Modular, self-hostable platform that runs an ensemble of deepfake detection models (image/video/audio) behind a single API gateway, fusing their outputs via voting/averaging/stacking.
IBM's differential privacy library, exposing DP mechanisms in a scikit-learn-compatible API for privacy-preserving machine learning.

OWASP GenAI Data Security Initiative's versioned scanner auditing GenAI/agentic repos against 21 data-security controls (credential/identity risk, training-data exposure, RAG access control, supply-chain CVE enrichment) via 107 pattern-matching rules, with SARIF/HTML output.

Open framework for confidential AI: runs model-serving containers inside Intel TDX / AMD SEV-SNP confidential VMs with NVIDIA H100 confidential computing, so weights stay encrypted in memory and unreadable even to a compromised host, with remote attestation for verifiable deployment.
High-performance exact and fuzzy (MinHash) deduplication CLI for large-scale text datasets, in Rust.

Easy-to-use knowledge editing and model-editing framework for LLMs, implementing memory-based, meta-learning, locate-then-edit and parameter-efficient methods, with dedicated multilingual (CKnowEdit) and multimodal (MiniGPT-4, BLIP-2, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2-VL) editors.
Tracks the energy consumption and environmental footprint of using generative AI models through API calls.

Given an embedding vector, identifies which model produced it by classifying characteristic numerical patterns in the model's output distribution. No LICENSE file or license declaration was found in the repo -- flagged for review, do not assume a permissive license.
Extensible framework for defining and running machine unlearning experiments, with 13+ pre-built unlearning methods for systematic comparative evaluation.
EU AI Act compliance tool performing risk classification and bias testing (via CrowS-Pairs), running entirely offline.

Open-source framework for evaluating, testing and monitoring ML and LLM systems, with 100+ metrics from data drift to LLM judges, pass/fail test suites for CI/CD, and a self-hostable monitoring dashboard.

Engine that generates zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs) of deep-learning model inference, usable from Python, JavaScript, or the CLI. No LICENSE file or license declaration was found in the repo -- flagged for review, do not assume a permissive license.
FAIRsFAIR Research Data Object Assessment Service -- automatically scores a dataset's Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability and Reusability against the FAIR principles.
Python package for assessing and mitigating group-fairness harms in AI systems, combining disaggregated fairness metrics for model assessment with a set of unfairness mitigation algorithms.

Runtime provenance capture and queryable database for AI/ML and scientific workflows -- what data was used/generated, where it ran, and how workflow artifacts relate to each other, with a Python API, CLI, REST API and web UI.
Friendly federated learning framework for training models across decentralised data without centralising it.

Open-source license-compliance system and CLI toolkit that scans files for license, copyright and export-control declarations, deduplicates findings across a whole codebase, and generates SPDX documents.
Open-source CLI + SDK toolkit that scans code, collects compliance evidence, and generates model cards, risk files and evaluation reports.

Command-line LLM vulnerability scanner that runs a large library of static, dynamic and adaptive probes with per-probe detectors against Hugging Face, OpenAI, Bedrock, Replicate, litellm, gguf and REST-accessible models.

Google's tools for creating and verifying signed 'launch endorsements' (golden firmware measurements) for Google Compute Engine Confidential VM firmware (SEV-SNP), letting a verifier check a VM's measurement against the golden reference.
Serverless, Terraform-deployable pipeline that automatically redacts sensitive information from PDF documents using Google Cloud DLP, Workflows and Cloud Run.
Fast Rust scanner that detects licenses, copyrights and package/provenance metadata across many ecosystems, builds full SBOMs with a closed dependency graph, and gates CI on license policy.
Open-source evaluation and testing library for LLM agents and ML models, scanning for vulnerabilities, bias, and other weaknesses.
Google's differential privacy libraries for generating (epsilon, delta)-DP statistics over datasets, including end-to-end frameworks for Apache Beam and JVM data pipelines.

Family of compact judge models that classify LLM prompts and responses for safety risks (jailbreak, bias, violence, sexual content), RAG hallucination/groundedness, and agentic function-call correctness, with support for custom criteria.

Python framework that wraps LLM calls in composable Input and Output Guards built from Hub validators, detecting and quantifying specific risk types in prompts and responses and triggering configurable on-failure actions.

Rubric-scored benchmark of 296 multi-turn dialogues and 2,818 expert-authored criteria measuring anthropomorphic capabilities of LLMs across personality, emotion, social, morality and motivation dimensions.

Toolkit of context-attribution explainability methods for LLMs: MExGen attributes generated text to parts of the input context, CELL builds contrastive edited prompts to show what drives different outputs, and Token Highlighter flags gradient-critical tokens for jailbreak detection.
Comprehensive, actively maintained benchmark and codebase for image manipulation detection and localization, distinguishing pristine images from edited/manipulated ones.
Modular open-source toolkit spanning safety/security checks, multiple explainability methods, fairness metrics and mitigation, and RAG hallucination quantification.

A Python framework from the UK AI Security Institute for building and running large language model evaluations, with built-in support for prompt engineering, tool use, multi-turn dialog and model-graded scoring.
CLI for creating, cryptographically signing and verifying C2PA provenance/authenticity manifests for ML models and datasets, with provenance links and transparency-log storage.
Java PDF redaction add-on that removes selected text, images or regions from documents entirely so the underlying content can no longer be extracted.
JavaScript library for building applications using secure multi-party computation, usable in browser, mobile, or Node.js.
Rust library and CLI that detects and masks PII across text, logs, JSON, CSV and SQL dumps using universal and locale-specific recognizers.
Client-side image redaction tool (browser and CLI) that uses local OCR to detect and blur PII such as emails, IPs, credit cards and API keys, with batch processing.

Multi-agent framework that reconstructs lineage graphs for post-training LLM datasets by tracing reuse, refinement, merging and derivation signals from Hugging Face dataset cards, GitHub, blogs and papers.
Interactive tool to visualize and attribute an LLM's generated text back to specific training data points.
One-for-all multimodal evaluation toolkit covering text, image, video, and audio, unifying many benchmarks under a single evaluation harness.
Open identity and provenance protocol for models, agents, harnesses and datasets, with a reference implementation, CLI tooling, and a live public registry with HTTP API.
Visual analytics system for comparative evaluation of machine unlearning methods.
Deep-learning-based file content-type detector (~99% precision/recall across 200+ types) that identifies a file's actual content type regardless of its extension or claimed type.
Open-source toolkit implementing multiple LLM text watermarking algorithms (embedding and detection), including several designed for robustness against paraphrasing/removal attacks.
Modular arena for benchmarking single- and multi-agent LLM systems, with pluggable agents/tools/datasets/evaluators.
Comprehensive platform for evaluating AI agents in dynamic, realistic environments.
Easy-to-use, powerful homomorphic encryption library enabling computation directly on encrypted data.

A configurable library for auditing data privacy in statistical and ML models via membership inference, range membership inference, dataset usage cardinality inference and differential-privacy lower-bound auditing.
Open-source ML lifecycle platform including a model registry for versioning, staging, and tracking updates to models.

Determines whether a model derives from a known base model by comparing multi-signal fingerprints (architecture metadata, tokenizer, weight parameters) against a reference database of ~150 base models across 45+ families, combining 8 provenance signals into a pipeline score.

name: Model Openness Tool
summary: A web application that evaluates and ranks machine learning model releases against the Model Openness Framework's 16 code, data and document components, validating the license declared for each component.
Massive Text Embedding Benchmark: state-of-the-art evaluation of embeddings across languages and tasks, the standard multilingual evaluation suite in its ecosystem.

A Python toolkit for adding programmable input, dialog and output guardrails between an application and an LLM, controlling permitted topics, enforcing conversational flows and blocking jailbreaks and prompt injections at inference time.

Neural network formal verification tool based on DPLL(T) SMT solving, supporting fully-connected, convolutional, residual and batch-norm layers with common activation functions; ranked 2nd overall at VNN-COMP 2024 and 2025.

Open-source interpretability platform for browsing and searching sparse-autoencoder features/latents across many open models, tracing attribution graphs/circuits, and steering model behavior by editing activations.
Package enabling interpreting and manipulating the internals of deep learned models.
CNCF-graduated, general-purpose policy engine for authorization decisions -- services query OPA with a request like 'can user X call operation Y on resource Z' and receive an allow/deny decision.
Benchmark for prompt injection attacks and defenses in LLMs.
Extensible framework unifying LLM unlearning evaluation across the TOFU/MUSE/WMDP benchmarks, 12+ unlearning methods, and 10+ evaluation metrics.
Framework for evaluating AI agent safety in realistic environments.

AI lifecycle governance platform: versioned, encrypted registries ('cards') for data, models, experiments, prompts, and agents, with a UI for visualizing lineage and a CLI/Python/YAML workflow across pre/deploy/post-deployment stages.
Benchmark platform providing real computer environments (real OS, real apps) for evaluating multimodal computer-use agents on open-ended tasks.

Production tool that generates AI Bills of Materials in CycloneDX 1.6 JSON format from Hugging Face repositories -- model card, licensing, dependency and provenance data -- with a completeness score flagging metadata gaps.

An interactive, framework-agnostic model-understanding server and notebook widget offering salience maps, embedding-space visualisation, slicing, custom metrics and counterfactual generation for text, image and tabular models.

Modular RLHF framework implementing SFT, RLHF and Safe RLHF with separate reward and cost models, released with human-labelled helpfulness/harmlessness preference data and pre-trained reward and cost checkpoints.

Application and Python scripts that identify likely PII columns in survey/field datasets using name, format, sparsity and location-population rules and then drop, encode, or keep them to produce a de-identified dataset.

A pluggable SDK and service for detecting and de-identifying personal data in text, images, DICOM files and structured data using named-entity recognition, regular expressions, rule-based logic and checksums.

Model-agnostic security framework of markdown rules and an MCP server that embeds secure-by-default coding practices into AI coding-assistant workflows (before/during/after code generation), covering input validation, secrets exposure, weak cryptography, unsafe functions, and missing auth logic.

A modular toolkit from the AI Verify Foundation that combines benchmark testing and automated red-teaming of LLMs and LLM-based applications, with a CLI, Web UI, APIs and customisable recipes and cookbooks.
Python Risk Identification Tool for generative AI -- Microsoft's open-source framework for automated red-teaming.
Perform data science and machine learning on data that remains on someone else's server.
Toolkit for quantitative evaluation of data attribution methods.
eXplainable AI toolkit for responsible, quantitative evaluation of neural network explanation methods (faithfulness, robustness, complexity, etc.), JMLR 2023.

An installable library registering 'rep-reading' and 'rep-control' HuggingFace pipelines for reading and manipulating population-level internal representations of LLMs, plus a RepReading-based model evaluation framework (RepE_eval).
Standardized adversarial robustness benchmark (NeurIPS 2021 Benchmarks and Datasets Track).

Tools for assessing the statistical disclosure risk of trained ML models via simulated membership-inference and structural attacks (post-hoc) and training-regime risk assessment (ante-hoc), before a model is released.
Local-first JavaScript/TypeScript library that detects and redacts PII using 570+ curated regex patterns with checksum and context-aware validation and multiple redaction modes.

name: License Pre-Validation Service
summary: Service that analyzes each patch for the open-source components and licenses it introduces and flags restricted licenses and potential violations with exact code locations.
Scans source trees and packages to detect declared/actual licenses, copyrights, and (now also) known vulnerabilities in code and dependencies; usable as a CLI or a library.

Dynamic benchmarking framework that uses multi-agent rewriting to generate semantically-equivalent, non-deterministic variants of code benchmarks (HumanEval, MBPP) plus a DyPass@K metric to evaluate code LLMs robustly under data contamination.
Game-theoretic approach (Shapley values) to explain the output of any machine learning model.

name: Synthetic Data Generator
summary: Framework for generating high-quality structured tabular synthetic data, supporting differential privacy and anonymization so the output is exempt from privacy regulations like GDPR while retaining the original data's essential characteristics.

Benchmark for the tamper-resistance of open-weight LLMs: red-teams models with fine-tuning, jailbreak-tuning, and embedding attacks under worst-case hyperparameter sweeps while tracking StrongREJECT safety and MMLU-Pro utility.

name: TensorFlow Data Validation
summary: Library for exploring and validating ML datasets at scale -- computing descriptive statistics, inferring a schema, and detecting anomalies/skew/drift across data batches.

CNCF Confidential Containers project's attestation and secret-management components: implements the verifier side of TDX/SGX/SEV-SNP remote attestation and gates secret release on the resulting evidence.

A pip-installable evaluation toolkit and benchmark covering six trustworthiness dimensions — truthfulness, safety, fairness, robustness, privacy and machine ethics — across more than 30 datasets, with an end-to-end generation and evaluation pipeline.

A Java explainable-AI library plus REST service and Kubernetes operator providing fairness metrics and model-agnostic explainers for predictive models, with connectors to black-box inference services such as KServe and ModelMesh.

A lightweight Python library that trains representation-engineering control vectors from paired contrastive prompts and applies them to a wrapped causal language model at inference, with GGUF export for llama.cpp.
Open and efficient video and image watermarking, embedding and detecting robust, imperceptible marks.

A no-code TensorBoard/notebook interface for probing black-box classification and regression models, running inference over large example sets, editing examples to generate counterfactuals, and comparing performance and fairness across dataset subsets.
Extensible open-source framework for evaluating the imperceptibility and robustness of watermarking methods (ASE 2025 tool demo).

NSF-funded open-source metrics/accounting framework for national HPC/research-computing allocations (originally for XSEDE/ACCESS): tracks job-level resource utilization per allocation, project, and user so funders and operators can audit how a granted compute allocation was actually spent.
Open, taxonomy-classified database of documented real-world AI incidents spanning many sectors and risk types.

Database of 1,000+ documented real-world incidents and controversies involving AI, algorithms, and automation, classified by harm type, sector, and technology across several taxonomies (including its own AI/Algorithmic/Automation Harms Taxonomy).
A high-level format for machine learning datasets

name: Data Privacy Vocabulary
summary: W3C Community Group vocabulary (RDF/OWL) for describing personal data handling -- processing purposes, legal basis, personal data categories, and technical/organisational measures -- in a machine-readable, interoperable way.

name: Frictionless Data Package
summary: Open specification for describing and packaging datasets with structured metadata (schema, provenance, licensing), enabling consistent assessment of a dataset's fitness for a given use.

name: Open Ethics Data Passport
summary: Open schema (JSON Schema) for documenting a dataset's origin, including annotation, labeler, and labeling-tool provenance -- distinct from general dataset metadata specs in specifically covering the labeling/annotation process.

name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
summary: Widely-adopted, community-maintained risk taxonomy and standard for LLM application security (part of the GenAI Security Project).

name: System Package Data Exchange
summary: Open standard for creating software bills of materials
Packages and versions AI/ML models, datasets, code, and config as OCI artifacts for reproducible, portable delivery.
Python library that versions, exports, and saves ML models to local or cloud storage with a queryable history.
OpenSSF specification for cryptographically signing ML models to prove their integrity and origin.
Kubernetes controller that generates CycloneDX ML-BOM documents at runtime for AI workloads, with auditor-traceable evidence per attribute.
Semantic SBOM/CBOM/AI-BOM diffing, quality scoring, and regulatory compliance validation for CycloneDX/SPDX documents.
Discovers every AI agent, model, and API present in an organization's infrastructure to produce an AI bill of materials.
Generates xBOMs (SBOM extended with AI, SaaS, and crypto components) from static code analysis.
Open-source, agent-first identity and access management platform with an auth server, MCP/LLM agent gateway, and support for OAuth, OIDC, SAML, WebAuthn, and MFA.
Autonomous Agent Identity Management System (AAIMS) for issuing and verifying identity to AI agents.
Identity, credential, and access management for AI agents and AI-powered workflows, from prototype to production.
